params.body:
The agenda on Bespreken held back Projecten and Mensen until the first ten relations were discussed, and within a step showed ten items at a time. The table decides what to talk about, so all three steps and all their items now show at once, in the same order.

- `Agenda::steps()` returns per step its items, done and total; `BATCH`, `open` and `shown` go.
- After a save, the next item still to do opens, now across all steps.
- The intro drops "telkens tien".

332 tests pass, pint clean.
